context: A retired exec advises on long-term strategy
purpose: Teach: ポートフォリオ/プリンター/返金/レジュメ/数式/パートナーシップ/概算/アフター

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ポートフォリオ理論、若い頃に学んだな。
lines.en: Portfolio theory—I studied that when I was younger.
lines.style: Reflective opening, gaze distant into memory. Warm, unhurried pace. Slight nostalgic smile in the voice. The ease of someone settling into a familiar thought.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。今はプリンター一台でも、複合機能を求める時代です。
lines.en: Yes. These days, even a single printer needs to do everything.
lines.style: Measured agreement with underlying earnestness. Small pause after 'Yes' to acknowledge what was said. Steady, conversational rhythm. Present and engaged, not lecturing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 返金対応、信頼の土台だ。
lines.en: How you handle refunds—that's the foundation of trust.
lines.style: Weight settles on each phrase. Slow, deliberate delivery. No rush. The tone of someone who has watched this truth play out over decades. Quiet conviction, not performance.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 若手のレジュメ、目を通して才能を見抜きたい。
lines.en: I want to read through the younger staff's résumés and spot the real talent.
lines.style: Focused, purposeful. Slight lean forward in intention. Clear-eyed and direct. Not scanning—genuinely looking. The concentration of someone who takes this responsibility seriously.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 評価数式、人を測りすぎるな。パートナーシップ、長く保て。
lines.en: Don't let formulas measure people too much. Keep partnerships strong over the long haul.
lines.style: Shift to advisory, gentle but firm. The cadence of lived wisdom—not instruction, but something earned. Pause between the two thoughts to let each land. Low register, steady.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 概算予算、確定前に二度確認します。
lines.en: I check rough budgets twice before they're locked in.
lines.style: Practical, matter-of-fact. The voice of someone who has learned carefulness through experience. No apology, no overdoing it—just clear procedure stated with quiet competence.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: アフターサービス、企業の魂だ。
lines.en: Customer care after the sale—that's the soul of the company.
lines.style: Final thought, grounded and complete. Spoken with quiet finality. Not rushed. The weight of principle closing the moment. A breath's space before the end, letting it settle.
